description: Example Hugging Face model IDs relevant to this cockpit. Not exhaustive — pick models based on your own evaluation, not this list alone.

models.description: Small, fast sentence-embedding model. Good default for local RAG retrieval (see docs/recipes/basic-rag.md) when you don't want to pay for a cloud embedding API.
Compact English embedding model with strong retrieval quality for its size; a common alternative to MiniLM for RAG pipelines.
General-purpose instruction-tuned chat model. Same family as the default model pulled via Ollama for local generation (models/ollama/Modelfile).
Compact instruction-tuned generation model; a lighter-weight alternative to Llama 3 for local/offline experimentation.
